name: Mosaic
description: Mosaic - Grid layout component with named areas
descriptionFull:
Mosaic - Grid layout component with named areas

Features: - Named grid areas for layout - Responsive: stacks on mobile, grid on desktop - Auto-generates column tracks - Validates column count vs template

props.name: template
props.description: Grid area layout. 1D: each string is a row of space-separated area names. 2D: each inner array is a row

props.name: columns
props.description: Custom `grid-template-columns` value or array of track sizes. Defaults to equal-width fractional tracks

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class for the grid element
